headerDisplay: Expose Emporia Vue circuits to Apple Home over Matter. This plugin publishes Matter accessories only; HAP is not used.

email.title: Emporia Email
email.description: Your Emporia Energy account email address.

password.title: Emporia Password
password.description: Used only for the first sign-in. After that the plugin stores a refresh token in Homebridge storage. Leave blank if a valid token already exists.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to ask Emporia for new readings. Emporia does not publish a rate limit; 60 seconds matches its 1MIN data and Home Assistant's integration.

splitChannels.title: One accessory per channel
splitChannels.description: On: each circuit is its own accessory, so it can be placed in its own room (Apple Home assigns rooms per accessory). Off: all circuits share one composed accessory.

hideMains.title: Hide mains
hideMains.description: Hide the whole-home mains accessory. Exposing mains and branch circuits together can double-count in Apple Home's Energy tab.

accessoryType.title: Default accessory type
accessoryType.description: Apple Home shows live wattage on the tile only for outlet-typed accessories. Use the Home app's Show As -> Light afterwards if you prefer a light tile.

solar.title: Allow solar / export
solar.description: Allow negative power and report exported energy. Leave off for import-only circuits.

nominalVoltage.title: Nominal voltage (optional)
nominalVoltage.description: When set, the plugin also reports voltage and derives current from power. This is an estimate, not a measurement. Leave blank to publish active power only.

channels.title: Channel overrides
channels.description: Optional per-channel names, visibility, and accessory types. Channel IDs look like Mains, Branch_1, or Merged_100.

deviceGid.title: Device GID (optional)
deviceGid.description: Leave blank to apply the override to every monitor with this channel ID.

channelId.title: Channel ID
channelId.description: Mains, Branch_1 ... Branch_16, Merged_100, Balance, or TotalUsage.
